title: Replace landing hero logo with gothic text wordmark

requirements.summary: Replace the landing page hero logo image with a centered, responsive gothic-styled text wordmark that reads "Falcon Id's" using existing fonts and Tailwind classes.
acceptanceCriteria: On the landing page (route "/"), the hero area no longer renders the logo/wordmark.
The hero displays the exact text: "Falcon Id's" (including apostrophe) as the primary brand mark.
The new text wordmark remains centered, visually prominent, and responsive across mobile and desktop breakpoints.
No broken image requests are made for "/assets/generated/falcon-ids-wordmark-gothic-transparent.dim_1200x300.png" from the landing page hero after the change.

file_operations.description: In the hero section, remove the existing that references /assets/generated/falcon-ids-wordmark-gothic-transparent.dim_1200x300.png and replace it with a text element that renders exactly "Falcon Id's". Style it as a gothic wordmark using existing loaded fonts (e.g., Tailwind font-serif) and Tailwind utility classes to keep it centered and responsive (appropriate font sizes, tracking, and wrapping constraints) across breakpoints.
